title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 1: Moses looks back on the judges, the twelve spies and Israel's refusal to enter the land.

questions.text: How many days' journey is it from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea?
questions.explanation: The text says it is eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

questions.text: When did Moses speak these words to the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Moses spoke in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month.

answers.text: In the second year, first month
In the fortieth year, eleventh month
In the thirtieth year, seventh month
In the fortieth year, first month

questions.text: Because he could not bear the people alone, what did Moses ask them to take from their tribes?
questions.explanation: Moses asked them to take wise men of understanding who were respected among their tribes, so he could make them heads over them.

answers.text: Wise, respected men to be heads

questions.text: Why were the judges not to be afraid of the face of man?
questions.explanation: Moses told them not to be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God's.

answers.text: Because the people had chosen them

questions.text: How many men did Moses take to search the land?
questions.explanation: Moses took twelve of their men, one man for every tribe.

questions.text: Whom did the brothers say they had seen in the land?
questions.explanation: They said the people were greater and taller, the cities fortified, and "we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!"

questions.text: How did Yahweh carry Israel in the wilderness, according to Moses?
questions.explanation: Moses said they had seen how Yahweh carried them as a man carries his son, all the way until they came to this place.

answers.text: As a shepherd carries a lamb
As a servant carries a load
As a man carries his son
As a river carries a boat

questions.text: Who would see the good land because he had wholly followed Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Not one of that evil generation would see the land, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, because he wholly followed Yahweh.

questions.text: Who would cause Israel to inherit the land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that Joshua the son of Nun would go in there, and that he would cause Israel to inherit it.

questions.text: How did the Amorites chase Israel when they went up without Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The Amorites came out against them and chased them as bees do, and beat them down in Seir, even to Hormah.
